invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.21.0 preserves Parts 1–26 and closes Part 27 End-to-End Validation & Production Hardening without a tenant schema change: every standalone Invoicing route is release-guarded, the dedicated release command runs Invoicing regressions, quality locks, module migrations, responsive and app-surface UI checks, ERP integration, TypeScript and the production build, and the Invoicing workflow executes that single release gate before main can be accepted.
